name: Santorini Sunset Escape
description: Experience iconic sunsets over whitewashed cliffs.
long_description: Spend your days exploring volcanic beaches and your evenings watching the famous Santorini sunset in Oia. Enjoy local Greek cuisine, wine tastings, and breathtaking views of the Aegean Sea.

name: Swiss Alps Adventure
description: A scenic mountain adventure in Switzerland.
long_description: Discover the beauty of the Swiss Alps with hiking, skiing, and picturesque villages. Ride panoramic trains and enjoy fresh alpine air surrounded by snow-capped peaks.

name: Tokyo City Lights
description: Dive into Tokyo's vibrant urban life.
long_description: Explore Tokyo’s blend of tradition and modernity. Visit ancient temples, dine on world-class sushi, and experience the bustling nightlife of Shibuya and Shinjuku.

name: Safari in Serengeti
description: Witness wildlife in its natural habitat.
long_description: Embark on a safari adventure across the Serengeti. See lions, elephants, and the Great Migration while staying in luxury lodges under the African sky.

name: Paris Romantic Getaway
description: Fall in love with the City of Light.
long_description: Stroll along the Seine, visit the Eiffel Tower, and indulge in fine French cuisine. Paris offers timeless romance and culture at every corner.

name: New York City Explorer
description: The city that never sleeps awaits.
long_description: Visit iconic landmarks like Times Square, Central Park, and the Statue of Liberty. Enjoy Broadway shows, diverse food, and endless entertainment.

name: Bali Tropical Retreat
description: Relax in paradise surrounded by nature.
long_description: Unwind on Bali’s beautiful beaches, explore lush rice terraces, and rejuvenate with yoga and spa treatments in Ubud.

name: Iceland Northern Lights
long_description: Experience Iceland’s dramatic landscapes, including geysers, waterfalls, and glaciers. At night, witness the breathtaking Northern Lights.

name: Rome Historical Tour
long_description: Explore the Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Vatican City. Enjoy authentic Italian cuisine while walking through centuries of history.

name: Great Barrier Reef Dive
long_description: Dive into the world’s largest coral reef system. Encounter vibrant marine life and crystal-clear waters in Australia.

name: Machu Picchu Trek
long_description: Journey through the Andes on the Inca Trail to reach the iconic Machu Picchu. A rewarding adventure filled with history and stunning views.

name: Dubai Luxury Experience
long_description: Visit towering skyscrapers, shop in world-class malls, and enjoy desert safaris with dune bashing and camel rides.

name: London Cultural Tour
long_description: Visit Buckingham Palace, the British Museum, and iconic landmarks like Big Ben. Enjoy theater in the West End.

name: Patagonia Wilderness Expedition
long_description: Explore glaciers, mountains, and remote wilderness in Patagonia. Perfect for hikers and nature lovers.

name: Hawaii Island Hopping
long_description: Visit multiple islands, each offering unique experiences—from volcanoes to beaches and lush rainforests.

name: Barcelona Art & Beach
description: A blend of art and seaside relaxation.
long_description: Admire Gaudí’s architecture, stroll Las Ramblas, and relax on Mediterranean beaches.

name: Canadian Rockies Road Trip
long_description: Explore Banff and Jasper National Parks with turquoise lakes, wildlife, and scenic drives.

name: Thailand Island Adventure
long_description: Visit Phuket, Krabi, and Phi Phi Islands. Enjoy beaches, temples, and vibrant nightlife.

name: South African Cape Town Escape
long_description: Visit Table Mountain, Cape Point, and nearby vineyards. Experience diverse landscapes and rich history.

name: Norwegian Fjords Cruise
long_description: Sail past towering cliffs, waterfalls, and charming villages in Norway’s breathtaking fjord region.
